# COBRA Framework

> Task dispatch, worker registration, and annotation-based discovery for interpreter and analysis systems.

Kotlin library providing `ITask`, `IWorker`, `IDispatcher`/`AbcDispatcher`, `AbcWorkshop`, and `WorkLicense`. Workshops group workers and expose them through annotation-based licensing; dispatchers route tasks to registered workers by `ITask.ID`. Workers process tasks and return results synchronously.

## Instructions for Agents

- Subclass `AbcWorkshop<W>` to group related workers. Annotate worker properties with a `@WorkLicense`-annotated annotation.
- Call `workshop.registerTo(dispatcher)` to register every licensed worker; call `licensedWorkers()` to read the `Map<ITask.ID, W>` instead.
- Use `AbcDispatcher<T, R>` as the dispatcher; implement `IDispatcher<W>` only for a non-map registry.
- Implement `IWorker<T, R>` with `fun work(task: T): R`. Manage concurrency in the caller.
- Pass `RegisterMode.REPLACE` to `register` to overwrite; omit `mode` to chain (`ATTACH`).
- Declare a `RegisterMode`-typed property on the license annotation to set the mode used by `registerTo`.
- Use `WorkLicense.getTaskID(annotation)` to extract `ITask.ID` from a `@WorkLicense`-annotated annotation instance.
- Never apply `@WorkLicense` to a property; apply it to the custom annotation class.
- Never leave a licensed worker property null; discovery throws `IllegalStateException`.

## Core API

- [Core](llms/core.md): `ITask`, `IWorker`, `IDispatcher`, `RegisterMode`, `AbcDispatcher`, `AbcWorkshop`, `WorkLicense`.
